title: glab api projects/${project}/iterations?include_ancestors=true&per_page=100 --paginate
description: The iterations of the project and of its groups, every one, which prints one such array per page, which kit draws as the iterations stage's in `modules/bash/forge/gitlab.sh` (forge/gitlab:iterations, with `modules/jq/forge.jq` forge::gitlab_iterations). A tier without iterations, or a token without the scope, answers 403 or 404, which kit reads as the feature off. The types are those of GET /api/v4/projects/{id}/iterations in GitLab's REST OpenAPI, https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab/-/raw/master/doc/api/openapi/openapi_v3.yaml, as https://docs.gitlab.com/api/project_iterations/ describes them.

title.description: Null for an iteration of a cadence that has no title, which kit names by its dates.

due_date.description: The last day of the iteration.
